title: Disinfection switch is commanded from the previous solve's action, one interval late
claim: The pump's disinfection switch turns on one cycle after the steps the plan books the anti-legionella cycle on: for a 06:30-07:00 window it is on 0 of 30 minutes inside the window and 30 minutes after it, and the space-only steps of the window stay in Heating mode (0 of 30 minutes Heating + DHW).
mechanism: `LegionellaGuard.async_track_cycle` (reached from `_update_current_state` -> `async_observe`, the first thing `_async_update_data` does) reads `self._action()`, the action the previous solve cut; the solve that adopts this step's legionella action runs after it, so the switch and the arbiter's `inp.disinfecting` (DisinfectionSwitch.memo) follow one interval behind, and the switch is not re-driven between cycles.

evidence.unit: minutes the switch reads on inside a 30-min booked window (30 on outside it)
evidence.machine: box B11 (shared container, Linux 6.18, ~/venv-ci Python 3.14.7, hastub)
evidence.contention_note: other finder seats on the box; counts only

perturbation.change: run LegionellaGuard.async_track_cycle again right after the solve adopts its action (--perturb track-after-adopt)
perturbation.observed_value: on_in_window 29 of 30, on_outside 1, mode Heating + DHW 29 of 30

metric_definition: minutes the disinfection switch entity reads on inside the steps whose plan dhw_reasons[k] is legionella (plain index), and outside them
phenomenon_property: An actuator driven from the action is driven from the action of the step it lands in: no write path reads an action older than the current solve's.

null_control.note: no step booked legionella: null_on_minutes=0; a 90-min window shows the same 30-min shift (59 of 90 in window, 31 after)

reproduction_steps: disinfect.py: switch writes turn_on at minute 61, turn_off at 91 for a window 30-60
the tank set-point does reach 60 C from minute 31 (the arbiter reads the new action), so the set-point and the switch disagree for the whole window
proposed_fix_scope: legionella/coordinator: drive the disinfection switch from the adopted action (after the solve's adoption, and on the step tick), not from the input read that precedes the solve.
